integrity: The theorem has a complete written characteristic-uniform proof and an executable independent coefficient checker; no independent expert verification or historical-priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Counts coefficient values, not geometric moduli points; only primes congruent to five modulo six; full Newton polygons away from the superspecial locus are not determined; unindexed covering priority remains a risk. Finite checks are corroborative and the symbolic proof is not an independent audit.
title: A reduced superspecial locus for a genus-four cyclic trigonal deformation in every characteristic \(p\equiv5\pmod6\)
